pull.title: net: enforce timeout interval for paused send peers
pull.body: Today it's possible to keep some peers running ancient versions paused for a long time. If such a peer is so slow to read as to not drain our send buffer down to the 1MB threshold within a reasonable time frame, we really shouldn't be wasting a connection slot on them. I picked 20 minutes as the reasonable time frame, since it's what we already use for ping timeouts today.
